text: dsh-waimai 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的外卖与商超工具插件。它通过 MCP 工具和会话卡片接入 DSH，并提供打包技能。用户可以查找附近店铺和商品、读取菜单与购物车、查看结算报价、确认下单并查询订单状态；也可配置定时任务预览。适合希望在 DSH 对话中完成淘宝闪购或盒马购物流程的用户。需要相应平台账号并完成登录。

dsh-waimai adds takeaway and grocery tools to DSH through MCP and conversation cards. Browse shops and products, inspect menus and carts, preview checkout totals, confirm orders, and check status. For Taobao Instant Commerce and Hema users with an account and completed sign-in.

能不能按商品名称搜索几家店的菜单？
我想查看购物车并先知道含优惠和运费的结算金额。
帮我在聊天里挑选餐品、选规格并确认下单。
我想查淘宝或盒马订单的官方状态。
I want to browse nearby takeaway shops and their menus from DSH.
Can I check my cart total before confirming a grocery order?
I need to search products across a few selected stores.
**dsh-waimai** 的功能「店铺与商品搜索」：店铺与商品搜索：按附近或最近订单分页浏览店铺，并在明确选择的门店中按名称搜索商品和菜单。
**dsh-waimai** 的功能「购物车与结算预览」：购物车与结算预览：读取淘宝或盒马购物车并获取实时报价，展示商品、费用与总额，供用户确认。
**dsh-waimai** 的功能「对话点餐与下单」：对话点餐与下单：在聊天卡片中展示菜单和购物车；提交前读取报价并要求用户明确确认。
**dsh-waimai** 的功能「订单和付款状态查询」：订单和付款状态查询：读取订单记录并核对官方状态；付款方式查询不扣款，付款需明确授权。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：插件页的「跨平台搜索」按所选账号分别查询淘宝闪购和盒马，展示商品所属店铺、平台显示价及分页；价格与库存以平台实时结算为准。闪购通过其 H5 搜索接口读取当前地址范围内的结果，沿用隐藏推广店铺设置；盒马按配送组查询，其他配送组按需加载。美团和京东尚未接入，页面分别显示其状态。各平台读取失败或部分结果未识别时分别提示，搜索结果不创建订单或付款。 商超加购记录与恢复规则见 [商超加购记录](docs/retail-cart-ledger.md)。

支付宝内联登录无法继续时，私有诊断区分请求未获显式提交、未识别步骤、额外确认、无可用入口、响应失败和表单呈现失败。协议诊断进一步区分列表、名称、链接格式、域名、路径、查询参数及协议编号问题，并单独标记额外协议字段。诊断仅含固定分类和布尔标记，不保存原始响应、错误、链接或身份信息，也不改变请求放行条件。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：支付宝登录验证完成后，支付配置显示当前收银台的「付款方式」。用户点击刷新读取可用方式，再明确选择；页面只按后台回读显示已选项，不自动付款。只支持无需开通、绑卡或额外协议的已返回方式；同名银行卡按当前会话引用区分。选择失败立即禁止使用旧方式继续付款，刷新只查询结果，不重发选择。方式引用不写入配置，也不作为跨订单默认银行卡；支付密码和金额限额仍是通用配置。真实付款尚未验收。

支付配置的「支付宝登录与验证」根据支付宝当前步骤显示登录方式、手机号或短信验证码输入框，通过认证私有 RPC 提交。后台使用独立浏览器中的官方页面执行原有风控 SDK；一次操作只放行一次对应请求，不自动重发验证码，验证码按官方要求接受四位或六位。输入提交后从页面状态清除，不进入普通配置或日志。已识别的登录协议显示官方公开链接，由用户阅读并主动勾选后才可提交手机号；刷新步骤、切换订单或验证会话后须重新确认。额外人机验证、注册、未知协议和未识别步骤停止内联操作，提供官方窗口处理入口。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：登录方式列表来自当前官方页面；选择后在本页继续填写手机号和验证码。该列表是登录入口，不代表已绑定银行卡或已选择实际扣款方式。选择入口只打开登录表单，不提交付款；过期的选项引用必须刷新后重新选择。

协议标题兼容官方单条展示的 `name` 和列表展示的 `text` 字段；标题互相冲突时拒绝继续，两种格式均保留相同的链接校验与用户主动勾选要求。

登录验证按所选账号继续已有的有效待付款订单及支付宝 H5 会话；缺少会话时后端拒绝准备或提交付款。当前不支持下单前独立登录，验证缓存仅保留在当前插件进程内。登录完成后重新核对原订单金额和 SDK 环境，才连接后台；设置页不付款。订单付款卡片的普通收银台连接仍可能调用平台付款提交接口，不属于设置页的仅验证操作。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：已登录的本机客户端可通过 `/waimai-login` 的 `retailSearch`、`retailCart`、`retailAdd`、`retailCheckout`、`paymentOptions` 和 `paymentPay` 调用现有商超与付款工具，不依赖模型生成。接口沿用 DSH 会话认证、严格参数校验、订单归属、报价有效期、预算与未知结果防重；`paymentPay` 不接受密码或支付链接，保存的密码仅由 Host 注入。所有请求携带 RPC 请求 ID，超时后查询原购物车或订单，不自动重发。此接口补齐不代表实付验收已完成。

H5 原始入口使用 `cashierMain` 初始化；从已核验的登录、密码或付款确认子页面连接后台时，按原页面参数使用 `refreshNoAuth` 或 `refresh`，保留当前会话。未知页面不猜测恢复动作。付款卡片区分业务拒绝、退出登录、额外验证、未知步骤和结果页面，并单独显示后台是否已提交；错误原文与会话参数不进入界面或日志。恢复失败不会替换原会话或重新付款，最终仍以官方订单和付款查询为准。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：开发中的 H5 后台支付分支通过认证私有 RPC 初始化原订单收银台，在内存中保留支付宝会话并提交一次服务器指定的付款步骤，不调用 Agent Pay CLI。`paymentH5Start` 只接受账号、订单、确认金额和私有会话材料，入口始终来自该订单的原始付款回包；`paymentH5Submit` 接受短期 H5 引用与一次性验证输入。两者不向模型注册，凭据、密码和 H5 原始响应不进入聊天、普通设置或日志。付款卡片提供连接收银台、打开支付宝登录验证、连接后台以及单次付款操作；“支付配置”可选择验证浏览器。独立验证窗口只允许已核验的登录与查询接口，付款在后台发起；登录 Cookie 与支付宝 SDK 环境数据仅留在账号所属进程内，卸载后清除。连接后台后，Agent 可用 `get_payment_options` 和 `pay_order` 继续同一 H5 会话；要求支付密码时使用支付设置中保存的密码，也可在私有付款卡片临时输入覆盖。真实付款尚未验收，不能作为已接通自动支付使用。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：“支付配置 → 支付密码”保存一份通用的六位支付宝支付密码，不绑定购物渠道或本地购物账号记录，未登录购物账号也可设置。同一购物账号重新登录、切换账号或渠道不会清空密码。密码通过认证私有 RPC 写入 DSH 的 `credentials` 服务，普通设置、模型参数和响应、日志不含密码。Host 每次付款读取当前值，通过隐藏的 H5 方法传入经核验的原订单会话，不带密码回退 CLI；购物账号、订单归属、实付金额和预算仍分别校验。这不增加尚未接通渠道的付款能力，也不替代支付宝首次登录、短信及额外验证。

旧账号记录中的密码只有一个值时，后台自动迁移；多个旧值不一致或旧记录损坏时，界面提示设置通用密码，不擅自选择。迁移保留原私有记录作为升级留底；点击删除会先禁用通用密码，再清理这些旧记录，防止重启后恢复已删除密码。保存与删除不重启插件，也不能撤回已发出的付款请求。默认本机凭据文件不提供操作系统加密，不能隔离同一系统用户的进程。见 [0.8.32 升级说明](MIGRATION-0.8.32.md)。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：H5 提交复用原付款记录和锁，发出请求前持久记录 `h5Submitted: true`；超时或响应未知时只查询原订单，不重新提交。服务器要求的额外协议、开卡或未核验动作停止后台提交。成功页本身不证明扣款，最终由原收银台或匹配订单的付款时间核对。新增可选账本字段的降级限制见 [0.8.26 升级说明](MIGRATION-0.8.26.md)。产生新付款尝试后不得恢复旧账本或删除防重记录。

收银台咨询和提交保留官方入口中的 `payEntrance`，未提供时沿用 `WAP`。配置官方 CLI 后，`ALIPAY_SDK` 响应的原始订单串可通过私有进程参数传给 CLI，不重建签名，也不当作浏览器链接或查询凭证。CLI 回包仍须通过官方结果核对，未知结果不重复付款。此路径已用合成数据验证；淘宝闪购后台自动扣款尚未通过真实验收。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：CLI 明确返回 `PAYMENT_LINK_UNSUPPORTED` 时，插件在当前进程内保留同一订单的原始官方收银台入口，供付款卡片继续打开；不重新创建订单或提交付款，也不把原入口当作 Agent Pay 查询凭证。入口不会写入日志或会话；进程重建后不可恢复时，只提供状态核对。其他失败或未知结果不触发此分支。

支付宝 CLI 的 `schemaVersion: 1.0` 错误回执也会解析。若返回 `PAYMENT_LINK_UNSUPPORTED`，会话付款卡片显示“不支持此收银台链接”，不把 CLI 拒绝当作官方付款失败或成功，不自动重试。已实测当前 CLI/服务拒绝淘宝返回的 `maliprod.alipay.com` 入口；配置和连接检查通过不代表此类订单可自动付款。

支付 CLI 未返回可解析 JSON 时，原始标准输出与错误输出仅保留在认证私有诊断的进程内存中，不进入模型工具结果、持久化文件或普通日志。普通日志只记录退出分类、退出码和输出字节数；超时、启动失败和非零退出不能据此判断是否扣款，也不触发重试。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：在「插件 → 外卖助手 → 支付配置」统一调整单笔实付上限、每日累计上限、支付模式、报价有效期和支付宝连接。检查连接只执行已保存路径的 `--version`，不查询钱包、不发起支付；修改后先保存再检查。连接正常只表示程序可运行，授权和真实付款结果仍由支付宝确认。商家白名单功能已移除，旧配置升级说明见 [0.8.20 升级指南](MIGRATION-0.8.20.md)。

可选接入[支付宝官方 Agent Pay](https://github.com/alipay/payment-skills)：配置 `alipayAgentExecutable` 为已安装官方 CLI 的绝对路径，`alipayAgentTimeoutMs` 为调用超时。留空保留原收银台方式。DSH 会话发起 `pay_order` 时，插件将本次官方支付材料和已确认的实付、商家交给 CLI；会话身份由 Host 提供，模型不能填写。需要验证时展示本次官方入口，未知结果只查询，不重复付款。密码和身份核验在支付宝官方流程完成。CLI 安装与接入资格遵循官方文档；真实支付验收须单独完成。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：付款记录新增可选 `provider` 和 `agentQueryRef` 字段，后者只保存本次官方 CLI 返回的查询订单号。签名链接和完整回执只留在进程内存，完整回执仅能通过认证私有诊断读取。旧记录继续可读；产生新字段后，降级必须保留当前付款记录并使用兼容读取器；不得恢复旧账本或删除新付款记录。CLI 输出前置日志时，只解析末尾带数字 code 或 success/status 的 JSON 命令结果，不从诊断日志提取支付入口；尾部非 JSON 或不完整结果保持未知。CLI 返回码或文字不会直接标记已付款，仍核对原收银台结果或匹配订单的付款时间。

商超收银咨询使用官方浏览器请求域名、web 容器和 WAP 来源信息；不伪造设备字段。待支付详情缺少付款时间时保持未确认状态。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：支付宝网页验证入口支持既有收银台域名，以及[官方文档列出的两种手机网站支付网关](https://developer.alibaba.com/docs/doc.htm?articleId=107095&docType=1&treeId=203)：`https://mapi.alipay.com/gateway.do` 和 `https://openapi.alipay.com/gateway.do`。网关仅接受此路径，保留原签名参数。日志记录地址拒绝分类和协议、域名，不记录完整地址或查询参数。未配置官方 CLI 时，`ALIPAY_SDK` 保持结果未知，不显示已可验证；仅打开官方验证入口不代表付款成功，仍须回查官方结果。

付款回包诊断记录固定的结果、动作、验证入口分类以及协议、域名，不记录支付 URL、SDK 载荷或 extraMap 内容。付款结果未知、已付或失败时隐藏普通付款入口；需要验证时仅展示本次付款保留在内存中的原始入口。原始入口丢失后不使用订单详情的自动支付入口代替，也不再次发起付款；这些修复不改变既有未知付款的结果。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：已发起付款的界面不再提示去官方客户端继续付款。未知结果只提示核对状态；原验证入口不可用时明确提示先核对付款结果、勿再次付款。插件购物车、结算卡和付款卡共用此提示规则。

付款状态的 paymentQueryAvailable 表示当前账号尚未终结的付款仍有原始收银查询参数，或配置了官方 CLI 且保有本次查询订单号/内存验证链接。重启后为 false 时，不代表刚查询了原付款请求，也不证明未扣款。官方订单取消与支付结果分开报告；缺少查询参数的未知付款仍保持 unknown，参数和验证入口不写入账本。

餐饮创建回包的 POST_STANDARD 付款入口按官方协议解包，eleme://cashier 只转换为官方 HTTPS 收银台地址；无法识别的入口保留已创建订单号，不推断付款成功。

淘宝闪购的会话卡片刷新与 Agent 结算各自保留未过期的报价引用，刷新不会覆盖另一份仍有效的报价。提交继续核验账号、地址、购物车、准确金额和有效期；已使用报价不可重复提交。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：淘宝闪购创建结果未知时，每一轮重试都必须重新取得用户明确授权并核对官方订单。retryOf 只能引用相同购物车最新且无后继的未知记录，实付不得增加；旧授权不可自动续用，历史和预算占用全部保留。

结算、提交与调整请求按官方 MTOP SDK 将 asac 放入 URL 查询参数。收银台支持解包 THIRD_PAY 的官方跳转链接，并用官方付款查询接口回写终态；查询参数仅留在进程内存，重启后仍保留付款记录且不自动重付。上述协议修正不等于真实创建订单和付款已经验收。

失败日志额外记录固定的消息关键词分类，例如地址、餐具或优惠券；不保留远端原文。分类只供定位，不能证明失败原因或允许重试。

get_order_status 可查询创建结果未知的记录，此时只核对官方订单，不调用要求订单号的收银台接口。仅已取得唯一订单号的记录继续核对付款；官方列表暂未匹配不代表确认无单。提交诊断保留限定格式的数字业务错误码，丢弃附带消息。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：DeepSeek Harness 多平台外卖插件。淘宝闪购和盒马通过 HTTP 读取账号、配送地址、历史订单与商品。闪购支持购物车、结算报价、页面确认创建订单和官方支付入口；盒马支持规格加购、实付报价和确认创建订单，付款在官方客户端完成；美团、京东尚未接入。

淘宝闪购结算与提交日志使用同一报价引用，区分网络失败、平台回包、报价核验失败和成功。日志只保留结构化协议状态与金额，不保存远端消息、订单载荷、地址或支付链接；实际购买仍需当前账号实测确认。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：淘宝闪购结算与提交携带同一淘宝渠道请求头，避免同一账号被按通用网页渠道计算红包。2026-10-26 只读实测：百岁山 570ml×24 的报价从使用 ¥10 红包、实付 ¥49.20，变为使用已爆涨的 ¥11 红包、实付 ¥48.20，与官方 App 一致；此次核验没有创建订单或付款。爆红包的官方触发接口已定位为 `mtop.alibaba.svip.langrisser.act`，需要券按钮下发的 `extInfo.supplyInst`；已爆涨券直接使用，未下发触发参数时不猜测或用会员兑换代替。本版本修复报价渠道，尚不执行新的爆涨请求。

dsh-waimai README · 插件页面：Agent 会话中的盒马商品提供「查看规格」弹窗；`get_product_details` 的工具卡片显示包装、最低数量、步长、库存和计价单位。历史工具结果提示重新核验价格和库存；刷新绑定记录中的账号，并复核当前配送地址。插件与聊天弹窗共用规格和数量选择、等待反馈及悬浮购物车；点击加购后仅在目标 SKU 数量及其他商品回读一致时显示成功。规格读取和加购重查原搜索页及门店售卖状态；非售卖时段或商品已移出该页时停止加购。称重商品和跨平台商品的加购方式未确认时停止。

购物车弹窗内部滚动商品，较多商品时保留标题和关闭入口。

盒马配送门店 ID 按集合稳定比较，接口仅改变 ID 顺序时不再误报地址变化；真实门店变化仍停止提交。下单诊断记录结构化返回码，不记录远端错误消息、凭据或支付链接；未知结果保留原请求记录并阻止重复提交。

dsh-waimai README · 插件页面：Agent 使用 `get_cart(platformId: hema)` 获取当前购物车版本，再通过 `add_product_to_cart` 提交 `productRef`、`skuId`、整数数量、`revision` 和固定的 `operationRef`。原生加购仅发送一次。完整购物车快照和结果保存在当前账号目录的 `hema-cart-attempts.json`；接口超时或回读延迟时只刷新购物车，重载后也不重发。未核对的操作会阻止新的加购。购物车价格不作为会员优惠、运费或最终实付的结算证据。

顶部统一选择平台和账号，账号选项标明淘宝扫码或短信登录；五个页签共用当前账号视图。淘宝闪购沿用 ele.me 的业务接口域名，页面使用淘宝闪购品牌。

淘宝扫码账号显示同一登录会话的淘宝昵称和本人头像；账号编号只放在账号详情。头像昵称与当前淘宝身份不匹配时不显示该头像，读取或加载失败显示昵称首字和刷新提示。昵称为空时显示未命名账号。读取前后同时核验淘宝身份和闪购业务身份，身份变化时停止显示资料。

dsh-waimai README · 插件页面：各渠道从平台注册表读取登录方式和默认入口。淘宝闪购提供淘宝扫码与手机号短信；盒马默认提供「手机号短信（淘宝授权）」，也可选择淘宝授权扫码或明确复用已登录淘宝账号。短信走阿里账号的官方网页入口，取得登录会话后独立核验盒马本人资料和订单，不伪称调用盒马 App 的设备登录接口。仅支持已有账号，需要注册或额外验证时停止；手机号和验证码只经私人页面提交。盒马 App 扫码尚未接通，选择它不会生成淘宝二维码。默认入口不宣称已经核实为官方推荐。账号格式变化见 [0.5.0 升级说明](MIGRATION-0.5.0.md)。

dsh-waimai README · 插件页面：- **账号与地址**：优先显示登录状态、头像、昵称、账号 ID、脱敏手机号和当前配送地址；其他地址折叠为可展开列表。已登录时隐藏登录表单，点击「添加账号」后显示当前平台的默认登录入口；淘宝闪购也可选手机号短信；短信入口提示订单可能属于不同账号。复核业务账号、资料和订单后才加入列表。多个账号保持独立登录，下拉只改变当前页面视图，不影响其他窗口或任务；切到任务或设置后返回仍保留所选账号。地址选择与账号绑定。
- **点餐**：顶部选择或更改配送地址，未选有效地址时不查询店铺。自动加载附近推荐店铺，展示图片、评分、月售、距离、配送时间和起送价，支持翻页及本页筛选；也可查看最近订单店铺。菜单支持分类、图片、标价、售罄及规格选择。单规格直接加购，多规格打开弹框选择份量、口味、配料和数量；显示加价、必选项及互斥选项。加购立即显示等待状态，购物车回读确认后显示成功反馈；失败保留具体原因。右下角悬浮购物车显示数量和金额，点击打开购物车弹框，可减一件、刷新及结算。结算显示平台实付、优惠、费用、商品、地址和配送时间；勾选确认再创建订单，随后点击官方支付入口。切换地址清空旧视图并丢弃迟到请求；同地址刷新失败保留已读结果。
- **历史订单**：优先显示商家、状态、时间、餐品和金额；订单号按需展开。支持刷新、下一页和返回最新记录；每次成功翻页替换当前列表，普通刷新失败时保留最后已校验的页面并显示重试入口，账号不一致时清除资料。

- **设置**：默认平台、预览和金额上限优先显示；结算报价有效期、人工支付说明与本机登录、分页设置按需展开。通过 Host 表单的版本检查保存修改，保留未编辑字段。
dsh-waimai README · 插件页面：未接入平台显示明确空状态，不读取淘宝账号或发送登录请求。切换平台或账号视图时销毁旧资料、地址、订单和店铺列表并丢弃迟到的请求。账号会话按平台和账号隔离，不同账号可并行读取；每个平台同一时间只保留一个待完成登录。默认账号数上限为 10，可配置到 100。美团和京东登录接口仍未接入，不能因多账号界面可用而视为其登录可用。

dsh-waimai README · 当前能力：盒马资料通过 `mtop.wdk.iseeku.user.profile.get` 读取，必须返回本人资料；头像只使用经过校验的 HTTPS 图片 CDN。地址来自 `mtop.wdk.lbs.location.UserAddressReadApi.getAllAddress`，配送门店由当前已选地址的 `decidedShopData.groupList` 确认；不将它们标成外卖附近推荐。订单使用 `mtop.hema.trade.order.buyer.list.search`，保留超出 JavaScript 安全整数范围的完整订单号，金额由分转元，订单时间按中国时区解析，分页与盒马账号绑定。每次私人读取前后复核身份。

dsh-waimai README · 当前能力：「门店与商品」选择配送门店后输入商品名称，调用 `mtop.wdk.search.item` 分页读取商品、标价单位、图片和库存状态；商品所属原生门店必须位于当前地址的配送组。成功翻页替换当前列表，失败保留最后已确认的一页；可返回首批。分页令牌只在后端保存，页面及模型仅获得与账号、地址、门店和搜索词绑定的随机引用。每个会话最多保留 32 个分页引用、1000 个商品引用；单次搜索超过 1000 件时要求更具体的搜索词，过期引用须重新搜索。

「查看规格」通过 `mtop.wdk.detail.openservice` 核对商品和原生门店，显示销售规格、最低数量、数量步长、库存及计价单位。只有接口明确标记价格未经转换时才显示规格标价，否则显示「价格暂无法确认」，`price` 与 `originalPrice` 为 `null`；不使用转换后的数字猜测价格。商品列表标价不代表结算实付。搜索词建议、跟踪数据、购物车动作、动态签名和购买链接不进入显示结果。

dsh-waimai README · 当前能力：盒马头像和商品图片仅接受允许的图片 CDN；接口返回的协议相对地址和 HTTP 图片地址转换为 HTTPS，仍拒绝含凭据、非默认端口、查询参数及外部主机的图片。

dsh-waimai README · 当前能力：用户在插件或会话卡片确认商品、地址和准确金额后，经 `mtop.trade.order.create` 单次创建订单。提交前获取共享记录锁、保存金额占用并回读；购物车或地址变化、超限、过期及重复商品均拒绝提交。结果未知时保留记录，不自动重试。用户在盒马 App 确认原请求没有生成订单后，可在新报价中再次核对金额，并明确确认重试一次。服务端将重试绑定原未知记录、相同账号、地址、商品及不高于原金额，禁止重复使用及重试链；原记录和预算占用不删除。原生参数和签名仅留在后端内存；付款在盒马 App 完成，官方订单状态确认付款结果。2026-10-21 已真实验证配送选择、完整报价和费用；真实创建请求未取得可识别订单号，订单接口未见对应新单，购买与付款尚未验收通过。

dsh-waimai README · 当前能力：淘宝二维码通过官方 `/havanaone/loginLegacy/qrCode/generate.do` 获取，并轮询 `/havanaone/loginLegacy/qrCode/query.do`。二维码在后端生成 PNG，临时令牌与 Cookie 不返回页面。每次扫码使用独立会话，取消、过期或切换页签会停止检查。淘宝确认后，通过 `mtop.alibaba.ucc.taobao.apply.usertoken` 与 `mtop.alibaba.ucc.oauthLogin` 换取闪购业务会话。仅接受 Eleme 站点的已确认会话，校验 Cookie 域名及账号 ID，再用业务接口复核本地 ID、Havana ID、资料与订单，全部通过后才保存。授权失败或额外验证时保留原账号；注册、绑定、换绑接口不会自动调用。

dsh-waimai README · 当前能力：打开插件页面的扫码入口后自动生成二维码。页面显示扫码、手机确认、完成登录三步进度；手机确认后自动复核业务授权，无需点击检查按钮。临时请求失败会自动重试，确认后的复核默认最多 60 秒；超时、淘宝会话未建立或平台要求额外验证时停止并显示原因，可重新扫码。取消或离开账号页会停止当前尝试。

`loginDiagnostics` 默认开启，启动器的 `web-host.stderr.log` 中按 `[waimai-login]` 和 `attemptId` 记录二维码确认、业务初始化、令牌与 UCC 接口返回码及授权类型、资料和订单核验、失败和取消。日志仅保留固定字段、类型与数量，不记录远端说明、URL、二维码内容、Token、Cookie 或个人资料；重复等待状态不重复记录。关闭该配置停止记录，登录行为保持原样。
dsh-waimai README · 当前能力：手机号登录的订单可能与淘宝账号所关联的闪购账号不同，仅改变订单查询渠道不能证明账号一致。真实验收已取得淘宝扫码对应的闪购会话，读取昵称、头像与当日订单，并与原短信账号分别保存。平台可能不提供手机号，此时不显示手机号。购买流程要求复核淘宝身份和独立的闪购买家会话；这两个 ID 不应直接比较。

dsh-waimai README · 闪购结算与购买：可选配料组的额度为 0 时仍展示基础规格和口味，配料禁选，不把 0 猜成无限制。零额度与默认或必选配料矛盾时停止；不绕过平台数量规则。

购物车使用 `mtop.eleme.waimai.carts.shop.operate.um`，结算使用 `mtop.alsc.bpgw.trade.order.build`，确认提交使用 `mtop.alsc.bpgw.trade.order.submit`，固定请求主机为 `alsc-buy2.ele.me`。加购从刚读取的菜单中提取 SKU，调用方只传商品引用，不能提供原生规格参数。减一件只调整指定商品，不清空其他商品或更改勾选状态。规格通过 `mtop.alsc.waimai.store.detail.item.purchased` 读取，各 SKU 的口味和必选配料分别校验。选择引用绑定账号、地址、店铺和商品，加购前重读价格、库存、配料与互斥规则；变化后要求重新选择。套餐、带组合规则或配料数量规则的商品仍停止加购。每次修改只发送一次，并以目标 SKU、口味、配料和数量回读确认；接口成功但数量未变化时提示核对购物车。

dsh-waimai README · 闪购结算与购买：报价核对当前账号、闪购买家会话、原始配送地址、店铺、SKU、数量和多个金额字段，不用菜单标价估算实付。原生结算参数和压缩提交数据只保留在后端，页面只接收展示字段、随机报价引用和有效期。付费附加服务或不支持的支付选项会停止。报价有效期可配置，默认 120 秒；购物车、账号、地址变化后旧报价不能提交。

自动任务预览默认开启，不创建订单。手动点餐可在插件页面或会话卡片中获取报价，明确确认商品、配送时间、地址和金额后创建本笔订单，无需关闭全局预览；单笔及每日上限在服务端检查。每日累计包含已创建订单和结果未确认的尝试，不自动因取消或退款返还额度。提交前写入共享本机记录并获取文件锁，不重试创建订单请求；未知结果、相同未变化购物车、重复确认和遗留锁都会阻止再次提交。请先核对官方历史订单，不能用重复提交检查是否成功。

dsh-waimai README · 闪购结算与购买：创建成功后，淘宝订单可以用 get_payment_options 读取官方收银台实付和当前付款方式；用户已授权付款时，pay_order 绑定订单、短期付款引用、准确实付和预算发起一次付款。付款前保存独立的 cashier-attempts.json；未知结果、重复确认或重启均不自动重付。仅支持平台当前选择的支付宝方式，不开通免密、信贷或充值。需要验证时，私有卡片提供官方入口；付款参数及链接不进入模型或付款记录。get_payment_status 核对官方订单；商超订单另外验证付款时间、账号和实付，取消或退款状态与付款状态分别显示。未取得付款成功证据时不能报告已付款。自动定时购买仍禁用。

dsh-waimai README · Agent 会话点餐：菜单和点餐准备结果中的 `orderingAvailable` 表示用户确认下单可用；`automaticOrderingAvailable: false` 表示自动购买不可用，`userConfirmationRequired: true` 要求明确用户确认。

会话中的店铺、菜单、推荐餐品、购物车、报价和付款工具结果使用公开 `tool.call.toolview` 展示卡片。点击店铺或餐品可在当前会话中选择规格、配料和数量、加购、减一件与结算；插件页面继续使用悬浮购物车，会话卡片使用内嵌购物车。卡片绑定记录中的 `accountRef`，不会随其他窗口切换账号。地址和付款 URL 只通过鉴权 RPC 读取，不写入模型结果。

dsh-waimai README · Agent 会话点餐：Agent 推荐时调用 `show_order`，只能使用当前菜单中的真实 `itemIds`。获得购物车 revision 后可调用 `get_item_options`、`change_cart`，再用 `submit_order` 请求真实报价。报价卡片重新读取当前购物车和报价，展示有效期、费用、优惠、配送地址和实付；预算超限、过期、身份或购物车变化阻止提交。用户确认后显示订单和官方付款入口；付款后刷新官方状态。请求成功或打开链接都不能当作已付款。迁移见 [0.3.0 说明](MIGRATION-0.3.0.md)。

下单阶段日志使用 `waimai-order` 分组，仅记录尝试引用、阶段和金额，不记录地址、账号、餐品、付款 URL 或凭据。订单结果未确认时保留预算占用，先查官方订单，不重试提交。

dsh-waimai README · 工具：模型工具：`list_platforms`、`list_connections`、`get_status`、`prepare_ordering`、`search_shops`、`search_products`、`get_menu`、`get_product_details`、`get_item_options`、`get_cart`、`change_cart`、`show_order`、`preview_checkout`、`submit_order`、`request_payment`、`get_order_status` 和 Host 的 `preview_task`。`list_connections` 只返回平台和本机保存的账号引用，不返回昵称、手机号或凭据；每次使用仍复核会话。浏览器记住上次的平台和各平台账号，刷新或重新进入插件时复核后恢复；仅保存引用，不保存昵称、手机号或登录凭据。浏览器间不同步，清除站点数据后回到默认选择。已移除的账号回到可用默认账号，平台验证或临时查询失败不会改查其他账号。多个账号时，账号工具必须提供对应 `accountRef`，不会按当前页面的选择改变其他调用。`search_shops` 的 `scope` 默认 `nearby`，分页查询已选地址的附近推荐；`recent` 查询最近一页订单店铺，`keyword` 仅筛选当前页结果，不能声称搜索平台全量商家。`get_menu` 要求返回的稳定 `shopId` 和该账号已选地址；盒马还须 `keyword`，后续页原样传回 `nextCursor`。`get_product_details` 用搜索结果的 `productRef` 读取盒马规格。模型结果不包含账号 ID、地址或私人平台分页令牌。淘宝点餐卡片支持用户确认提交；未接入平台返回结构化错误。原有调用迁移见 [0.2.5 迁移说明](MIGRATION-0.2.5.md)。

dsh-waimai README · 工具：短信、账号资料、地址、完整历史订单、确认提交与私人支付入口仅在鉴权的 `/waimai-login` RPC 可用，内部端点不注册给模型。模型购物车工具复用相同账号所有者，只返回商品、金额及版本。`preview_checkout` 要求淘宝平台、`accountRef` 和 `shopId`，返回不含地址或支付链接的报价；`submit_order` 用 `accountRef`、`shopId` 和 `maxAmount` 生成预算内的确认卡片；`request_payment` 和 `get_order_status` 用本机订单引用核对官方状态。实际创建需明确购买授权，可通过确认卡片或 confirm_order 提交；付款授权和准确金额另由 pay_order 核对。官方付款入口从私人 RPC 读取，不进入模型结果。手机号、验证码、Cookie、地址和购物车摘要不写入共享配置；异常消息不返回网络 URL 或令牌。见 [0.2.16 升级说明](MIGRATION-0.2.16.md)。

dsh-waimai README · 配置：`mcpNodeExecutable` 只选择外卖 MCP 解释器，不修改系统 Node.js、宿主或其它子进程。配置重载沿现有串行队列重启 MCP；正在执行的定时任务结束后再应用最新配置。清空路径会恢复使用宿主解释器。显式路径无法启动时报告 MCP 连接失败，不退回其它解释器。该字段不修改可执行文件的名称或图标；部署者须先提供已设置相应 Windows 资源、版本兼容的 Node.js 可执行文件。

任务包含唯一非空 `id`、`name`、`platformId`、`enabled`、`triggerTime`（本地 `HH:mm`）、`dateRule`（`workday/weekend/everyday/custom`）、`customDays`、`skipDates`、`menuPool`（每行 `店铺 | 菜品 | 参考价格`）、`menuStrategy`（`rotate/random/history`）、金额限制和通知选项。每分钟轮询，仅触发指定分钟，不补跑错过的任务。同一任务每天只触发一次，先保存触发记录再执行预览或失败通知。
dsh-waimai README · 配置：旧浏览器、自动支付和自动领券字段保留加载兼容，当前不执行相应操作；结算优惠以平台报价为准。升级已有调用与任务前阅读 [0.2.0 升级说明](MIGRATION-0.2.0.md)。

dsh-waimai README · 本机数据：文件均位于 `$DSH_HOME/waimai/`，未设置时使用 `~/.dsh/waimai/`。`accounts.json` 保存平台账号引用和已验证的显示资料，凭据和配送地址引用分别在 `accounts/<platform>/<uuid>/login-state.json` 与 `delivery-selection.json`。手机号输入、验证码、地址文本、完整历史订单和未确认扫码会话不持久化；`trade-attempts.json` 独立保存下单金额、账号、购物车指纹、结果、订单号与私人支付入口，用于避免重复提交。即使关闭记住登录，下单尝试仍持久化。每次使用重读账号与地址，缓存资料不能证明会话有效。本机私人缓存不进入共享配置。

首次加载会把旧 `login-state.json` 和配送地址引用复制到一个独立淘宝账号目录，保留原文件；索引成功保存后只使用新账号目录。重复登录已保存身份时刷新该条目，旧凭据文件保留用于恢复。取消添加只清除待完成登录，不删除已有账号或凭据。升级说明见 [0.2.2 多账号说明](MIGRATION-0.2.2.md)。

dsh-waimai README · 本机数据：扫码成功且闪购业务复核通过后，先保存在独立待登录账号目录，再加入账号索引。扫码不读取已有账号的 Cookie，也不会用已有账号的订单冒充扫码账号的订单。含凭据的旧备份只留在本机。

`automation-state.json` 保存触发和预览历史，`notifications.jsonl` 记录任务通知，`mcp-server.log` 为进程日志。既有 `browser-profile/`、截图、支付流水及 `payment-state.json` 保留原处，不会清理未确认的预算占用，也不被用于点餐。含账号数据的运行目录、截图和抓包文件不可随环境同步或发布。

0.8.6 的商超结算通过平台地址接口关联当前已选地址与淘宝地址，不通过收货人文字猜测，也不更换地址。一口价商品没有红包组件时仍使用平台最终实付；地址关联缺失、重复或结算返回不同地址时停止下单。附近推荐店铺查询不等于全平台搜索，未经逐店结算不能宣称最低实付。

dsh-waimai README · 商超 Agent 下单：商超预约配送未选时段时禁止提交。`preview_retail_checkout` 的 `deliveryPreference: earliest` 明确选择平台当前最早可配送时段，经调整接口重新计价并返回送达时间；默认 `platform` 保留平台已选时段。订单结果未知时保留记录和金额；核对官方记录无新单且得到重试授权后，`confirm_order` 可传原 `retryOf` 与 `previousOrderAbsent: true`，仅允许相同购物车、金额不增加的一次重试，不删除原记录，不允许连续重试链。

0.8.21 接受淘宝收银台实际返回的 `https://maliprod.alipay.com` 支付目标。新订单保存已确认商品摘要并传给支付宝；缺少摘要的旧单不会发起 Agent Pay。新增可选持久化字段与降级要求见 [迁移说明](MIGRATION-0.8.21.md)。

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：`mcpNodeExecutable` selects the Node.js executable for the takeaway MCP child. It defaults to an empty string, which uses the Host's `process.execPath`. A deployment can provide a matching Node.js executable with its own Windows process name and icon. This setting does not modify executable resources, the system Node.js installation, the Host or other child processes. Configuration reloads replace the MCP process through the existing serial lifecycle; an active scheduled task finishes before the latest configuration applies. Clearing the path restores the Host interpreter. An explicit path that cannot start reports an MCP connection failure without selecting another interpreter.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：The plugin page provides account-bound product search across Taobao Instant Commerce and Hema, showing each product's store, listed price and continuation. Final prices and availability are confirmed at checkout. Taobao search uses its H5 delivery-area endpoint and preserves the sponsored-shop visibility setting; Hema searches delivery groups and loads additional groups on demand. Meituan and JD remain unavailable. Partial or unrecognized results are reported per platform; searching does not place an order or make a payment. Retail additions use an account-owned durable journal: uncertain results block another addition until an exact cart readback confirms the previous one. See the [retail cart journal](docs/retail-cart-ledger.md) for retention and recovery.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Private inline-login diagnostics distinguish requests without an explicit action, unsupported steps, additional confirmation, missing eligible channels, response failures and form presentation failures. Agreement diagnostics distinguish list, name, URL, host, path, query and agreement-ID failures, and separately flag a named protocol. Diagnostics contain fixed categories and boolean flags only, without raw responses, errors, URLs or identity data. Request admission rules remain unchanged.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：After Alipay verification, payment settings show the current cashier’s payment methods. Users explicitly refresh the available choices and select one; the UI shows the backend-confirmed selection without paying. Only returned methods requiring no enrollment, card binding or additional agreement are selectable. Session references distinguish identically named cards. An unconfirmed selection blocks payment; refreshing reads back the result without selecting again. References are not persisted as default cards across orders. The payment password and spending limits remain shared settings. Live payment acceptance remains incomplete.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Alipay sign-in in payment settings displays the login-channel choices, phone or SMS field requested by the current provider step and submits it through authenticated private RPC. An isolated backend browser runs the official page and its existing risk SDK. Each explicit input permits one corresponding request; SMS is never resent automatically and accepts the provider's four- or six-digit length. Submitted inputs are cleared from UI state and excluded from ordinary settings and logs. Recognized login agreements show official public links and require the user to check consent before phone submission. Refreshing the step or changing the order or verification session clears consent. Additional human verification, registration, unknown agreements and unfamiliar steps stop inline input and offer the official window.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Login choices come from the current official page. Selection opens the phone form in settings and does not submit payment. These are sign-in entries, not verified linked cards or a selected funding source. Expired choice references require refreshing the current step.

Agreement titles accept the official inline `name` and list `text` fields. Conflicting titles are rejected; both forms retain the same link validation and explicit user consent.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Verification continues the selected account's valid pending order and existing Alipay H5 session; the backend rejects preparation or payment submission when no session exists. Sign-in before order creation is not supported, and verification material remains in the current plugin process. The backend rechecks the original order amount and SDK environment before connecting the verified session. Settings verification does not pay. The ordinary cashier connection in an order payment card can still call the platform payment submission API; it is distinct from settings-only verification.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Authenticated local clients can call the existing retail and payment tools through `retailSearch`, `retailCart`, `retailAdd`, `retailCheckout`, `paymentOptions` and `paymentPay` under `/waimai-login`, without model generation. These routes retain DSH session authentication, strict input validation, order ownership, quote expiry, spending limits and unknown-outcome safeguards. `paymentPay` rejects passwords and payment URLs; saved credentials are injected only by the Host. Requests carry an RPC request ID. After a timeout, query the original cart or order instead of resending. Live payment acceptance remains incomplete.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：The original H5 entry initializes through `cashierMain`. Connecting an observed login, password or pre-confirmation subpage resumes through `refreshNoAuth` or `refresh` according to its current parameters. Unrecognized pages stop without guessing a recovery action. Payment cards distinguish provider rejection, sign-out, external verification, unsupported steps and result displays, separately indicating whether the backend submitted payment. Provider text and session parameters stay outside the UI and logs. Failed recovery preserves the original session and never resubmits payment; official order and payment queries remain authoritative.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：The H5 backend payment branch under development initializes the original order's cashier through authenticated private RPC, keeps Alipay session data in memory, and submits one server-directed payment step without Agent Pay CLI. `paymentH5Start` accepts the account, order, confirmed amount and private session material; the destination always comes from that order's original payment response. `paymentH5Submit` accepts an ephemeral H5 reference and verification input. Neither endpoint is exposed to the model. Credentials, passwords and raw H5 responses stay out of conversations, ordinary settings and logs. The payment card connects the cashier, opens Alipay verification, connects the backend and submits one payment. Payment settings select the verification browser. The isolated verification window permits observed login and query APIs only; payment is submitted by the backend. Cookies and SDK environment data remain in the account process and are cleared at unload. After connection, the Agent can continue the same H5 session with `get_payment_options` and `pay_order`; password challenges use the saved payment credential or a one-time override in the pri

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Payment settings save one shared six-digit Alipay payment password independently from shopping channels and local shopping account records. Shopping sign-in is not required to configure it; reconnecting or switching shopping accounts or channels does not clear it. Authenticated private RPC writes to the public DSH credentials service. Passwords stay outside ordinary settings, model inputs/results and logs. The Host resolves the latest value for the verified original order's hidden H5 continuation, without a CLI fallback. Shopping identity, order ownership, final amount and spending limits remain separately enforced. This does not enable payment on unsupported channels or replace initial Alipay sign-in, SMS and additional verification.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：A single distinct legacy password migrates privately; conflicting or damaged legacy records require an explicit shared setting. Migration retains the old private records for upgrade recovery. Removing the shared password first disables it, then clears legacy records so they cannot restore it after restart. Saving and removal do not restart the plugin or cancel already dispatched payments. The default local credential file is not OS-encrypted and cannot isolate processes running as the same OS user. See [0.8.32 migration](MIGRATION-0.8.32.md).

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：H5 submission shares the existing payment ledger and lock, persisting `h5Submitted: true` before sending. Timeouts and unknown responses require original-order reconciliation, never another submission. Additional agreements, card enrollment and unverified server actions stop backend submission. A success page does not establish payment; the original cashier or matching order's paid timestamp remains authoritative. See [0.8.26 migration](MIGRATION-0.8.26.md) for downgrade restrictions. Never restore an old ledger or remove deduplication records after a new payment attempt.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Cashier consultation and submission preserve the official entry's `payEntrance`, retaining `WAP` only when absent. When the official CLI is configured, original `ALIPAY_SDK` order strings pass through private process arguments without rebuilding signatures or treating the strings as browser URLs or query credentials. Official results still determine payment status; unknown outcomes cannot be retried. Synthetic tests cover this path; live Taobao background payment acceptance remains unverified.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：When the CLI explicitly returns `PAYMENT_LINK_UNSUPPORTED`, the plugin retains the same order’s original official cashier URL in process memory for the payment card. It does not create another order, resubmit payment, or use that URL as an Agent Pay query credential. The URL is excluded from logs and sessions; after process restart, an unavailable link allows status checks only. Other failures and unknown results do not activate this path.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：The adapter also parses CLI error receipts with `schemaVersion: 1.0`. `PAYMENT_LINK_UNSUPPORTED` appears on the conversation payment card without settling the official payment status or retrying. The current CLI/service has rejected a `maliprod.alipay.com` entry returned by Taobao in live testing; a saved configuration or successful connection check does not establish automatic payment support for these orders.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：When the payment CLI returns no parseable JSON, raw stdout and stderr remain in memory behind authenticated private diagnostics, outside model tool results, persistent files and ordinary logs. Logs retain only execution classification, exit code and output byte counts. Timeout, spawn failure and nonzero exit do not establish payment status or authorize a retry.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Open Plugins → Takeaway assistant → Payment settings to configure the final per-order cap, daily budget, payment mode, quote lifetime and Alipay connection. Check connection runs only `--version` at the saved executable path; it does not query a wallet or submit payment. Save edits before checking. An available executable does not establish wallet authorization or payment success. Merchant whitelists have been removed; see the [0.8.20 upgrade guide](MIGRATION-0.8.20.md).

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Optionally integrate the [official Alipay Agent Pay CLI](https://github.com/alipay/payment-skills) with `alipayAgentExecutable` (an absolute installed executable path) and `alipayAgentTimeoutMs`. An empty path retains the existing cashier flow. A DSH `pay_order` call privately hands the original provider material, confirmed amount and merchant to the CLI. The Host supplies session identity; model arguments cannot supply it. Verification uses the current official handoff, and unknown results permit queries only. Password and identity verification remain in the official Alipay flow. Follow official installation and eligibility requirements; live payment acceptance remains a separate verification step.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Payment records add optional `provider` and `agentQueryRef` fields. The latter retains only the query order number from this payment receipt. Signed links and full receipts remain in memory; full receipts are available only through authenticated private diagnostics. Existing records remain readable. After new fields have been written, downgrades must retain the current payment ledger and use a compatible reader; never restore an old ledger or remove newer payment records. When CLI output contains leading logs, only the terminal JSON command result with a numeric code or success/status fields is parsed; diagnostic records never supply payment references. Trailing non-JSON or incomplete output remains unknown. CLI return codes or messages never directly mark an order paid; reconciliation uses the original cashier result or matching official order payment time.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Alipay browser handoffs accept the existing cashier hosts and the exact HTTPS `mapi.alipay.com/gateway.do` and `openapi.alipay.com/gateway.do` endpoints documented in the [official WAP migration guide](https://developer.alibaba.com/docs/doc.htm?articleId=107095&docType=1&treeId=203). Signed query parameters are preserved. Diagnostics contain fixed destination rejection categories and the protocol and hostname, without complete addresses or query parameters. Without a configured official CLI, `ALIPAY_SDK` remains unknown instead of advertising an unavailable verification step. Opening verification does not establish payment success; the official result must still be queried.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Payment diagnostics record fixed result, action and handoff classifications plus protocol and hostname, never payment URLs, SDK payloads or extraMap contents. Unknown, paid and failed attempts hide generic payment links. Verification can resume only through the original handoff retained in memory; losing that handoff does not expose an automatic-payment order page or authorize another payment request. These changes do not resolve an existing unknown payment outcome.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：After a payment attempt, the cart, checkout and payment cards no longer instruct users to continue payment in the official app. Unknown outcomes instruct users to check status. Missing original verification links explicitly instruct users to check the payment outcome and not pay again.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Payment status includes paymentQueryAvailable for a nonterminal payment with original cashier query parameters, or a configured official CLI and the current query order number or in-memory verification link. A false value after restart does not mean that the original payment was queried or that no charge occurred. Official order cancellation remains separate from an unknown payment result. Query parameters and verification destinations never enter the ledger.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Supermarket cashier consultation uses the official browser host, web container and WAP source without fabricating device fields. A missing payment timestamp in a pending order remains unconfirmed.

Restaurant POST_STANDARD creation responses unwrap the official payment envelope. Only eleme://cashier is normalized to the official HTTPS cashier. Unrecognized handoffs retain the created order IDs without implying payment success.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：For Taobao orders, conversation-card refreshes and agent checkout retain their own unexpired quote references. A refresh does not replace another valid quote. Submission still checks account, address, cart, exact amount and expiry; a consumed quote cannot be submitted twice.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Each retry after an unknown Taobao creation result requires renewed explicit user authorization and official order reconciliation. retryOf must identify the latest unknown attempt for the same cart with no successor, and the amount cannot increase. Authorization never carries forward automatically; history and reservations remain intact.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Checkout, submission and adjustment send asac in URL query parameters as the official MTOP SDK does. The cashier unwraps official THIRD_PAY handoffs and reconciles terminal results through the payment query API. Query parameters remain in process memory; restarts preserve the payment ledger without retrying charges. These protocol fixes do not establish live order or payment acceptance.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Failure diagnostics also include fixed message-term categories such as address, tableware or coupon, without retaining remote text. Hints do not establish a failure cause or authorize a retry.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：get_order_status can inspect an unknown creation attempt without invoking cashier methods that require an order ID. Only a created attempt with one order ID proceeds to payment reconciliation. An empty official match does not confirm absence. Submission diagnostics retain bounded numeric business codes and discard accompanying messages.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Taobao checkout and submission send the same Taobao channel header so coupons are priced for the intended channel. A read-only check on 2026-10-26 changed a 570 ml × 24 water quote from ¥49.20 with a ¥10 coupon to ¥48.20 with the already upgraded ¥11 coupon, matching the official app; it created no order or payment. The official upgrade endpoint is `mtop.alibaba.svip.langrisser.act`, using the coupon button's server-issued `extInfo.supplyInst`. Already upgraded coupons need no upgrade request. Missing parameters are never guessed or replaced with membership exchanges. This release corrects quote routing; it does not activate new coupon upgrades.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Taobao checkout and submission diagnostics share a quote reference and distinguish transport failures, platform responses and quote validation results. Logs retain structured protocol status and amounts without remote messages, order payloads, addresses or payment links. Live purchasing still requires verification with the current account.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Hema delivery store IDs are normalized before address checks, so reordered IDs do not invalidate checkout; changed store membership still stops submission. Order diagnostics retain structured return codes without remote messages, credentials or payment links. Unknown outcomes retain the original attempt and block duplicate submission.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Taobao Instant Commerce and Hema. Account-scoped HTTP provides sign-in, addresses, history, products and carts. Hema supports integer SKU additions, verified checkout quotes and confirmed order creation; payment continues in the official app. Meituan and JD are not integrated.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：QR accounts show the Taobao display nickname and self portrait from the same authenticated session. A portrait with another native nickname is rejected. Missing or failed portraits use the nickname initial with a refresh notice. Account IDs remain in account details; an absent nickname uses the unnamed-account label. Both the Taobao identity and ordering identity are checked around the read; changed identities stop profile display.

dsh-waimai README · dsh-waimai：Each platform declares its login methods and default entry. Taobao provides QR and SMS. Hema defaults to SMS through Taobao authorization, with QR authorization and explicit reuse of a signed-in Taobao account as alternatives. SMS uses the official Alibaba account web flow, then verifies the Hema self profile and history independently; it does not claim to use the Hema app device login interface. Registration and additional verification stop the flow. Phone numbers and codes stay in private settings requests. Hema app QR remains unavailable and never silently starts a Taobao QR attempt. Defaults do not claim verified official recommendations. The local account index adds taobao-sms; Hema credential writes use version 2 while version 1 remains readable. Downgrades require restoring pre-upgrade local backups. Credential backups stay on the local machine.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：Hema products open a specifications modal. get_product_details renders pack sizes, minimum quantity, quantity step, stock and pricing units. Recorded details require a fresh check. Refresh uses the recorded account and its currently selected address; changed identities, invalid references and failed refreshes discard old details. Plugin and conversation controls share SKU and quantity selection, pending feedback and a floating cart modal. Its item list scrolls within the modal so the title and close control remain visible. Success requires a matching SKU quantity delta with every unrelated line retained. Detail refresh and add re-read the original catalog page and store sale status. Closed sale periods and products missing from that page stop additions. Weighted and cross-platform products stop when their native add semantics are unconfirmed.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：Agents read get_cart with platformId hema, then add_product_to_cart with productRef, skuId, integer quantity, revision and a stable operationRef. Native additions are sent once. The complete before snapshot and result remain in the private account file hema-cart-attempts.json. Timeouts and delayed readback require only cart reads; reload never resends. An unresolved attempt blocks new additions. Cart display prices do not establish membership discounts, delivery charges or the final amount due.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：search_shops returns an opaque nextCursor for nearby merchant pages, including pages with no keyword matches. Positions are bound to the account, query, scope and native delivery selection; reloads, expiry or eviction require restarting from the first page. Advanced settings expose browseCursorSeconds and browseCursorLimit.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：search_products reads current menus in up to ten explicitly selected stores. Results retain product names, pack descriptions, listed prices and availability, and declare selected-stores-only scope. Failed stores remain visible with complete: false. Explicit platform empty-store responses display their notice; unexplained or malformed responses remain errors. A case of water requires verification of bottle capacity, bottle count and the actual SKU; listed prices cannot establish the lowest checkout total.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：Menu and preparation results use orderingAvailable for interactive ordering, automaticOrderingAvailable: false for disabled automated purchasing, and userConfirmationRequired: true for explicit confirmation.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：The public tool.call.toolview slot renders shops, menu recommendations, carts, checkout confirmations and payment handoffs inside the conversation. show_order uses real menu itemIds and an optional budget. Users can choose variants, required extras and quantity, add items, remove one unit and request a quote inside the card. Plugin pages retain their floating cart; chat cards use an inline cart.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：Agents can read get_cart and get_item_options, then change_cart with the current revision and validated selection references. Cart changes do not create orders. submit_order requires accountRef, shopId and maxAmount in yuan; it reads the real checkout total and returns a user confirmation card. The card refreshes the quote and checks the account, selected address, cart revision, expiry and budget before submitting. An explicit user confirmation can place a manual order while automation preview stays enabled. Scheduled purchasing remains disabled.

dsh-waimai README · Agent ordering：For an owned Taobao order, get_payment_options reads the official amount and selected payment method without charging. With explicit payment authorization, pay_order verifies the prepared reference, exact cents and spending cap, then submits one payment request. cashier-attempts.json reserves the attempt before sending; ambiguity, repeated confirmation and restarts never retry a charge. Only the selected Alipay method is supported; credit, account funding and new recurring authorizations are excluded. Verification handoffs stay in private authenticated UI RPC. get_payment_status reads official order state and, for supermarket orders, independently checks the payment timestamp, account and amount. Cancellation and payment are reported separately. URLs, provider parameters and credentials never enter model results or the payment ledger. Live payment acceptance remains pending.

dsh-waimai README · Installation and validation：Optional ingredient groups with zero allowance keep base variants available and disable extras. Zero is never interpreted as unlimited. Contradictory defaults, required extras or quantity rules stop the operation.

dsh-waimai README · Installation and validation：Install a fixed Git SHA through the managed DSH plugin installer. The package ships lib/ directly and has no build step. Run npm run check and npm test. Chinese documentation in README.md describes each configuration field, platform API and prior live validation. Migration guidance is in MIGRATION-0.3.0.md.

dsh-waimai README · Installation and validation：maxOrderAmount caps each order; dailyBudget caps daily reservations when nonzero. dryRun defaults to automation preview. loginDiagnostics records allowlisted login, cart and order stages without credentials or personal data. Existing local account and order files stay under DSH_HOME/waimai and never belong in environment sync.

dsh-waimai README · Installation and validation：Hema checkout resolves serviceable shop and location IDs through ShopDecideApi.decideByAddressId, then calls mtop.wdk.hema.cart.confirm and mtop.trade.order.build. Explicit lineIds and the current cart revision select quote items without changing official cart selections. Each selected product must currently have quantity one. The owner verifies address, SKU, quantity, listed subtotal, discount, shipping breakdown and consistent totals. Extra charges, additional agreements and ambiguous replies stop submission. The quote is shared by the plugin page and Agent confirmation cards.

dsh-waimai README · Installation and validation：Checkout selection is separate from phone selection. Only available lines with supported quantities enter the initial checkout selection; unsupported phone selections cannot block another product's quote. Hema delivery choices use mtop.trade.order.adjust for server repricing. A sole available option is selected and verified automatically; multiple choices appear in the plugin and conversation card. Changes replace the quote reference and clear amount confirmation. Missing selections, stale references and inconsistent totals prevent submission. Native delivery IDs and adjustment parameters stay in backend memory.

dsh-waimai README · Installation and validation：Confirmed Hema orders use one mtop.trade.order.create request after a shared lock, durable budget reservation and readback. Changed addresses or carts, expired quotes, exceeded limits and duplicates stop before creation. Unknown outcomes stay reserved and are never retried automatically. After checking the official app and confirming that the original request created no order, the user may explicitly authorize one retry from a fresh quote. The server binds it to the original unknown attempt, buyer, address and items, with no increase in amount. Reuse and retry chains are rejected; original records and reservations remain intact. Native parameters and signatures stay in backend memory; complete payment in the Hema app and verify official order status. Live delivery selection, checkout and shipping totals were verified on 2026-10-21. Real creation requests returned no recognizable order ID and the order API showed no matching new order; successful purchasing and payment remain unverified.

dsh-waimai README · Supermarket orders through the Agent：Version 0.8.5 adds native Taobao Instant Commerce supermarket search, single-SKU cart additions, and checkout. Use search_retail_products, get_retail_cart, add_retail_product, and preview_retail_checkout. After explicit purchase and budget authorization, confirm_order creates one order through the existing account, delivery, budget, and duplicate-attempt checks. Limits apply to the final payable total including delivery after discounts. Products requiring additional properties or SKU selection are not supported for additions yet. request_payment resolves current pending supermarket payment actions in the private chat card; payment URLs never enter model output or persistent logs. Use get_payment_options, pay_order and get_payment_status for authorized Taobao payment initiation; additional platform verification remains in the official window.

dsh-waimai README · Supermarket orders through the Agent：Version 0.8.6 resolves the selected Eleme address to its Taobao address through the platform address API without matching recipient text or changing the selection. Fixed-price items retain the server's final payable amount when the unused coupon component is empty. Missing, ambiguous, or mismatched address links prevent submission. Nearby recommendations are not a full-platform search; lowest-payable claims require actual store checkout comparisons.

dsh-waimai README · Supermarket orders through the Agent：Reservation-only supermarket checkout requires a selected delivery time. Set `deliveryPreference: earliest` on `preview_retail_checkout` to choose the earliest currently available platform slot and obtain a repriced quote with its delivery time; the default `platform` preserves the platform selection. After official reconciliation confirms an unknown attempt created no order and the user authorizes a retry, `confirm_order` accepts its `retryOf` and `previousOrderAbsent: true`. Restaurant and supermarket submissions share the same renewed-authorization rules described above; all attempts and reservations remain.

dsh-waimai README · Supermarket orders through the Agent：Version 0.8.21 accepts the exact HTTPS maliprod.alipay.com destination returned by Taobao. New orders retain the confirmed item summary for Agent Pay; older orders without it cannot initiate Agent Pay. See [migration requirements](MIGRATION-0.8.21.md) for the optional durable field and downgrade backup.
